# OptiVir Ads

> Performance Digital Marketing Agency specializing in Search Engine Optimization (SEO), High-Intent Google Ads (PPC), Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram), Google Maps Marketing, and Custom Web Development for ambitious businesses across Kerala and the GCC.

## Core Capabilities
- **Search Engine Optimization (SEO)**: Technical SEO audits, local keyword research, authority link-building, FAQ schema implementation, and Core Web Vitals optimization.
- **Google Advertising (PPC)**: High-intent Google Search, Shopping, and Performance Max campaigns optimized for target Cost-Per-Acquisition (tCPA) and verified phone calls.
- **Meta Advertising**: High-converting Facebook & Instagram campaigns, custom creatives, multi-angle copy, and funnel retargeting.
- **Google Maps Marketing**: Google Business Profile (GBP) optimization, geo-citations, Map Pack 3-Pack ranking, review acceleration, and local call tracking.
- **Social Media Management (SMM)**: High-retention content creation, brand positioning, and community management.
- **Custom Web Development**: Ultra-fast React & Next.js websites and landing pages engineered for maximum conversion rates and sub-second load times.
- **Analytics & Operations**: Server-side tagging, Google Tag Manager, GA4 conversion tracking, and offline CRM attribution.

## Service Locations
- **Kerala, India**: Kannur (Headquarters), Kochi, Calicut, Thrissur, Trivandrum, and statewide.
- **GCC / Middle East**: Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ras Al Khaimah (UAE), Doha (Qatar), Saudi Arabia.

## Verification & Trust
- **Methodology**: ROAS-first, transparent ad spend tracking, zero vanity metrics.
- **Pricing & Engagement**: Free Marketing Audit & Strategy Session, performance-tied retainers, and transparent monthly packages.
